title: Scheming Behavior in Tool-Constrained Agentic Settings

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly informs tool-gating decisions in agentic deployments. If scheming rates increase with tool availability, this defines practical risk thresholds for production systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires building or replicating agentic scheming scenarios with progressively gated tool access (text, code, file I/O, web search). Setting up sandboxed tool environments is infrastructure-heavy and beyond beginner skill level even with mentor guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four tool-availability conditions across multiple scheming scenarios. Each condition requires a different sandboxed environment. Measuring strategy diversity adds qualitative analysis. Far exceeds 30 hours.
